answer_text:
While Namebeam tracks AI visibility and maintains daily dated records of what search engines like Perplexity cite, specific summary metrics—such as the exact count of unique web domains cited globally by Perplexity across all daily questions from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-27—are not explicitly totaled as a single figure in their public indexing documentation. Hugging Face +1
Namebeam publishes its raw findings, tracking data, and individual market panels across separate dedicated repositories:
The Raw Dataset: Daily CSV files containing the full citation records are hosted on Hugging Face.
The Code and Log Repository: The raw text transcript responses are saved in an append-only public repository on GitHub.
The Market Panels: Granular breakdowns showing which domains Perplexity cited most during September 2026 are organized by industry and city on the Namebeam Markets Platform.
To extract the exact consolidated number of domains across that precise timeframe, one would need to compile and filter the distinct domain fields directly from the daily CSV logs on Hugging Face. Hugging Face
